ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture that leaves “Good Lovin’” intact and avoids chopping up the drum solo.
ai_review.review: The reviewer gives a glowing five‑star rating, praising the decision not to split “Good Lovin'” into separate tracks and noting the handling of the drum solo as a single piece. The recording is appreciated for its continuity and appears to be a clean soundboard source, making the performance enjoyable despite the lack of detailed musical commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one enthusiastic review (5 ★) with no criticism; strong positive sentiment but limited data for a robust rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Track kept whole, drum solo not split into separate track; clear and uninterrupted playback.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows naturally with “Good Lovin’” presented as a continuous performance, avoiding unnecessary edits.
